Privacy Policy

Updated on November 04, 2025

What is this Privacy Policy for?

This privacy policy is for this website & being served by Wugweb (including its global affiliates) and governs the privacy of its users who choose to use it. This website and its owners take a proactive approach to user privacy and ensure the necessary steps are taken to protect the privacy of its users throughout their visiting experience. The policy sets out the different areas where user privacy is concerned and outlines the obligations & requirements of the users, the website and the website owners. By accessing or using our website, you expressly consent to our collection, use and disclosure of your personal information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

Information We Collect

We may collect, store and use the following kinds of personal/non-personal information:

  • Information that you provide to register with us for availing our services, attending our company's event, subscribing to a newsletter or for submission of an employment application
  • Information about your computer and your visits to and use of this website (including your IP address, geographical location, browser type and version, operating system, referral source, length of visit, page views)
  • Information that you send to us to obtain a quotation/offer/proposal for our services
  • Information that you provide to us to subscribe to our website email notifications
  • Any other information that you voluntarily choose to send to us

Usage of Information We Gather

We require this information to understand your needs and expectations and provide you with a better service, and in particular for the following reasons:

  • To help us develop, customise, deliver, support and improve our services
  • For our internal purposes (such as auditing, data analysis, and research to improve our services and communications)
  • When you enter your contact information or send an email or other communication to Wugweb, we may retain those communications to process your inquiries and respond to your requests
  • We may periodically send promotional emails about our achievements, special offers or any other information we think you may find interesting using the email address you provided
  • From time to time, we may also use your information to contact you for market research purposes

Any information gathered by us may be shared, if appropriate, with any Wugweb offices, affiliates and subsidiaries worldwide. Wugweb may share some or all of your personal information with another business entity should we plan to reorganise, spin out, merge with, acquire, or be acquired by that business entity.

Information Security

Wugweb strives to protect your personal information. To prevent unauthorised access or disclosure, we have put in place suitable physical, electronic and managerial procedures to safeguard and secure the information we collect online. Unfortunately, no data transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

International Data Transfers

Information we collect may be stored and processed in and transferred between any of the countries in which we operate to enable us to use the information per this privacy policy. By using our Website, you consent to such transfer of information.

External Links

Users are advised to adopt a policy of caution before clicking any external links mentioned on this website. The owners of this website cannot guarantee or verify the contents of any externally linked website despite their best efforts. Users should therefore note they click on external links at their own risk.

Social Media Platforms

This website may use social sharing buttons that help share web content directly from web pages to the social media platform. Users are advised to use such social sharing buttons at their discretion. This website and its owners cannot be held liable for damages or implications caused by visiting shortened links.

Control your Personal Information

You may choose to restrict the collection or use of your personal information by writing to or emailing us at hello@wugweb.com. We will not sell, distribute or lease your personal information to third parties unless we have your permission or are required by law. If you believe that any information we are holding on you is incorrect or incomplete, please write to or email us as soon as possible. We will promptly correct any information found to be incorrect.
